mapper.select: SELECT principal.subject_id, profile.principal_id, profile.avatar_file_id, profile.version FROM iam_principal principal INNER JOIN iam_default_profile profile ON profile.principal_id = principal.id AND profile.deleted = 0 WHERE principal.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND principal.principal_type = 'DEFAULT' AND principal.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_default_profile SET avatar_file_id = #{avatarFileId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE principal_id = ( SELECT id FROM iam_principal WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND principal_type = 'DEFAULT' AND deleted = 0 ) AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE iam_default_profile SET deleted = 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE principal_id = ( SELECT id FROM iam_principal WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND principal_type = 'DEFAULT' AND deleted = 0 ) AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_default_profile WHERE principal_id IN ( SELECT id FROM iam_principal WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND principal_type = 'DEFAULT' ) AND deleted = 1
